subject: POC timeline, owners and final readout - Novus Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: proposed POC timeline & checklist (next steps)

Ethan — great to chat earlier. Appreciate the clarity on the three evaluation priorities you shared (response accuracy on clinical Q&A, throughput for batch document processing, and predictable latency under concurrency).

Based on the call, attached is a compact POC plan I drafted for Novus Health. High-level proposal:

- Kickoff: Mon, May 24 — 60m technical + product scoping
- Week 1: Baseline ingest & sample dataset verification
- Week 2: Performance tuning (batching/quantization) + latency SLO testing
- Week 3: Accuracy evals (50 canonical prompts + 2000 doc batch runs)
- Final readout: Fri, Jun 11 — 90m demo + decision gate

Success criteria (proposed — please confirm):
1) Accuracy: >= 86% on the clinical Q&A rubric we've included
2) Latency: p95 under 800ms for interactive queries (expected concurrency 8-12)
3) Throughput: sustained 2k docs/hour for batch pipeline

Owners: Redwood infra/POC lead (Ben) for performance, Customer success (Monica) for evaluation artifacts, Sales (me) for project coordination.

Can you confirm the target final-readout date works for you and who from your side should attend the kickoff? I've attached the schedule + an editable SOW draft so procurement can start their review.

Next steps: if you confirm, I'll calendar the kickoff and share a short mutual action plan (owners+milestones) with meeting invites.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: novus-poc-schedule-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-sow-draft-v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@novushealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: proposed POC timeline & checklist (next steps)

Kimberly — thanks for the crisp summary. The dates look good and Jun 11 as final readout aligns to our internal approvals timeline.

Quick questions/updates from our side:
- We'll have our ML Ops lead (Sofia Ramos) join the kickoff and own the dataset handoff.
- Procurement wants the SOW redline window — can you confirm you can accept a 7-business-day review? We'll need a signed SOW to enable Dedicated instance provisioning.
- On success criteria: can we make accuracy target an 80-90 band with ability to show test-by-test breakdown at readout? Also request an additional metric: deterministic output rate for model reranks (we can explain in kickoff).

Please loop in whoever owns provisioning and infra so we can surface any network/VPC needs early.

Thanks,
Ethan

Adding a quick notes + capacity ask from infra:

- We can provision a Dedicated test slice for the June window but need signed SOW or an order form by Jun 1 to reserve the GPU pool.
- Network: Novus will need to provide a whitelist of CIDRs for the demo nodes or we can run via hosted mode with IP allowlisting. If they want VPC peering, that adds ~3 business days to setup.
- I'll own p95 latency tuning and will put together a short runbook for the kickoff. Monica — can you confirm the evaluation rubric spreadsheet (I've left comments on the Drive copy)?

Ben
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@novushealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Kickoff May 24 + weekly syncs, prep items (Novus POC)

Ethan — thanks for the fast reply. Confirming kickoff: Monday, May 24 at 10:00am PT (60m). I'll send the invite to Sofia and your procurement contacts.

Prep & asks ahead of kickoff (please share by May 21):
- Sample dataset (S3 link or secure Drive) + test-case list for the accuracy rubric
- Procurement primary contact and PO/contract timeline (so we can schedule Dedicated provisioning)
- List of attendees and their roles (Sofia for ML Ops, Product lead, Security reviewer if possible)

I've attached the updated schedule and a mutual action plan doc — Ben will bring the infra runbook and Monica will bring the evaluation templates. We'll do weekly 30m syncs (Mon mornings) and a final 90m readout on Jun 11.

If procurement needs the SOW redline window, please expect a 7-business-day review cycle; we'll accept redlines and aim to finalize by Jun 3 to meet provisioning lead times.

Looking forward — I'll send calendar invites now.

Best,
Kim

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
